meta.method_note: Nearly every news/government domain is blocked from this box for direct fetch (egress proxy CONNECT 403 for curl; WebFetch EGRESS_BLOCKED for every outlet tried: nbc4i, 10tv, abc6, wosu, wyso, ideastream, whiznews, yahoo, columbusnavigator, thereportingproject, cedarnews, forth.news, mesonet, weather.gov, waterdata.usgs.gov). closure_extent.value: Both directions closed near Exit 129 (SR-79). Effective through-traffic gap per ODOT detours: EB traffic off at SR-158 (exit ~126, Kirkersville), back on at SR-13 (exit 132, Jacksontown); WB traffic off at US-40 Gratiot exit 142 (Muskingum Co line), back on at SR-310 (exit 118, Etna). Exit-to-exit bounds are implied by the detour routing, not stated as formal closure limits — INFERRED.

lake_level_and_dam.value: NO statements found on Buckeye Lake pool level, ODNR dam operations, or spillway operation during this event. Static reference (Buckeye Lake Beacon, 2018-19 articles): full pool 891.63 ft msl; Sellers Point spillway crest 892.21 ft msl; AMIL spillway in village opens automatically ~6 inches above spillway level; Sellers Point discharges up to ~2,000 cfs. The 881.5-883.5 ft figures in evacuation coverage are the RIVER gauge (BCLO1) datum, not lake pool elevation.
